# Environment
![](images/setup.png){style="width: 200px; border-radius:5px;  background-color: white" fig-align="center"}

Below are the instructions to setup your environment.

## New terminal setup
![](images/terminal_ibm.png){style="width: 200px; border-radius:5px;  background-color: white; border: 10px solid white" fig-align="center"}

You will need to use a different environment for this part.

To open a new terminal:

1. Right click on background/desktop of vnc
2. Select "Terminal"

## MaAsLin3 directory
![](images/directory.png){style="width: 200px; border-radius:5px;  background-color: white" fig-align="center"}

Make an d change into a directory named `~/adv_R_comm/maaslin3`.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
mkdir ~/adv_R_comm/maaslin3
cd ~/adv_R_comm/maaslin3
```

## Mamba
![](images/mamba_logo.png){style="width: 200px; border-radius:5px;  background-color: white" fig-align="center"}

Load the conda/mamba environment `maaslin3` with a use script made for this environment.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
. usemaaslin3
```

::: {.callout-note}
Instructions on creating the environment for your own future analysis are in the [appendix](/appendix/mamba.qmd).
:::

## Jupyter
![](images/jupiter.png){style="width:150px; background:white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

Activate `jupyter-notebook`.

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
jupyter-notebook
```
